paper_sections.title: Promoter haplotypes of interleukin-10 gene linked to cortex plasticity in subjects with risk of Alzheimer's disease
2.8 Statistical analysis involving demographic and neuropsychological data

description.value: The study examined whether IL-10 promoter ATA haplotype status was associated with hippocampal functional connectivity and cognitive performance in amnestic mild cognitive impairment and healthy control subjects.

design.value: A cross-sectional resting-state functional MRI study using a 2 × 2 voxel-wise ANOVA with groups (aMCI and controls) and IL-10 haplotypes (without ATA and with ATA), followed by post-hoc group comparisons and correlations with neuropsychological scores.

description.value: A measure used in aMCI diagnosis and to evaluate cognitive functioning.

Used to evaluate episodic memory.

Used to evaluate psychomotor speed and non-episodic memory.
Used to evaluate executive function and non-episodic memory.
Used to evaluate visuospatial skills and non-episodic memory.
A composite score calculated by averaging z-scores for auditory verbal learning test-delayed recall and Rey-Osterrieth complex figure test-delayed recall.
A composite score calculated by averaging z-scores for digit span, symbol digit modalities, trail making test-A, trail making test-B and clock drawing test.

description.value: Subjects meeting Petersen et al. recommendations for aMCI, including subjective memory impairment, objective memory impairment, MMSE score of 24 or higher, CDR of 0.5, no or minimal impairment in activities of daily living, and absence of dementia.

description.value: Images covering the whole brain were acquired using a 3D spoiled gradient echo sequence; TR = 9.9 ms; TE = 2.1 ms; FA = 15°; acquisition matrix = 256 × 192; FOV = 240 mm × 240 mm; thickness = 2.0 mm; gap = 0 mm.

instrument.value: General Electric 1.5 Tesla scanner (General Electric Medical Systems, USA) with a homogeneous birdcage head coil

description.value: 30 contiguous axial slices were acquired using a GRE-EPI pulse sequence parallel to the anterior commissure–posterior commissure line; FA = 90°; acquisition matrix = 64 × 64; FOV = 240 × 240 mm; thickness = 4.0 mm; gap = 0 mm; in-plane resolution = 3.75 × 3.75 mm; 142 volumes in 7 min and 6 s.

The first eight volumes were discarded; remaining images were corrected for timing differences and motion effects, spatially normalized into the SPM5 Montreal Neurological Institute echo-planar imaging template, resampled to 3 × 3 × 3 mm3 voxels, smoothed with an 8 × 8 × 8 mm3 Gaussian kernel, detrended and temporally bandpass filtered.

steps.value: The first eight volumes of the scanning session were discarded to allow for T1 equilibration effects.
The remaining images were corrected for timing differences and motion effects.
Participants with head motion of > 3 mm maximum displacement along any axis, or 3° of any type of angular motion were excluded.
The resulting images were spatially normalized into the SPM5 Montreal Neurological Institute echo-planar imaging template using default settings.
The normalized images were smoothed with a Gaussian kernel of 8 × 8 × 8 mm3.
REST software was used to remove the linear trend of time courses.

model_settings.value: Bilateral hippocampus was used as the ROI; the mean ROI time series was correlated with every voxel time series; Fisher's z-transform was applied; six head motion parameters and mean global, white matter and cerebrospinal fluid signals were introduced as covariates; voxelwise-based grey matter volume correction was applied.

level.value: subject-level functional connectivity maps followed by group-level analysis

estimator.value: Cross-correlation analysis followed by Fisher's z-transform

model_settings.value: 2 × 2 ANOVA: groups × haplotypes; groups: aMCI and controls; haplotypes: without ATA haplotype and with ATA haplotype; corrected p < 0.05 determined by Monte Carlo simulation with single voxel p = 0.05, minimum cluster size 10,503 mm3, FWHM = 8 mm, with mask.

estimator.value: Monte Carlo simulation for multiple comparisons

model_type.value: independent-samples t-test and Pearson correlative analysis

model_settings.value: Mean functional connectivity within the mask of ANOVA interactions was extracted for each subject; independent-samples t-tests were used for group comparisons and correlations were performed between neuropsychological test scores and mean functional connectivity.
